name: Cube or Treat NE 2026
information: ## Cube or Treat We're celebrating Halloween at Cube or Treat! **Costumes are strongly encouraged** for competitors and spectators, and we'll have candy, a costume contest, and other Halloween-themed surprises throughout the day. We've planned a **shorter competition day** so competitors and families can still enjoy Halloween evening after the competition. Check out the [**Halloween**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeorTreatNE2026#80217-halloween-at-cube-or-treat) and [**Costume Contest**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeorTreatNE2026#80216-costume-contest) tabs for more information! --- This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png) ​ Feel free to join and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
